capabilities: Render a note as a styled one-page report with cards, big numbers, funnels, tables and a Mermaid Gantt timeline
Edit note text in place on the rendered page and save edits back to the Markdown note
Create pages from report templates or fill them with AI from existing notes
Export pages as HTML or PDF and switch between seven light/dark themes
Publish a page to myone.page for browser-based, end-to-end-encrypted two-way editing
extras: Freemium: pages, editing, HTML export and AI filling work free without an account; web sharing needs an account, is free for 3 pages, and a paid plan beyond that. The sharing server is a separate, non-open-source service. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. PDF export is desktop-only; the plugin sends network traffic only after sharing or entering a token.
problem: Presenting a note to investors, clients or teammates means rewriting its content into a separate formatted document that readers without Obsidian cannot open.
